description: This file contains functions for exporting database recordsets in various formats such as CSV and tab-delimited text. It provides utilities to output to strings, files, and stdout, including handling of field titles, special characters, and recordset traversal.

methods.name: rs2csv
methods.description: Converts a recordset to a CSV string, optionally including titles.

methods.name: rs2csvfile
methods.description: Exports a recordset to a CSV file given a file pointer.

methods.name: rs2csvout
methods.description: Outputs a recordset as CSV to standard output.

methods.name: rs2tab
methods.description: Converts a recordset to a tab-delimited string, optionally including titles.

methods.name: rs2tabfile
methods.description: Exports a recordset to a tab-delimited file.

methods.name: _adodb_export
methods.description: Core function that handles exporting recordsets to CSV or tab-delimited formats, with options for titles, escaping, and output targets.
